title: UPPSC GIC Lecturer Answer Key 2026
intro: Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the answer key for the recruitment of Lecturer (GIC) posts on its official website. This recruitment was released for 1516 posts. Applications for the UPPSC GIC Lecturer Recruitment 2025 were accepted from August 12, 2025, to September 12, 2026. The online examination was held on 14 & 17 June 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPPSC GIC Lecturer Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
